text:
nina: FYI saw a spike on console heatmap load in canary after the routing + quota tweak last night. p95 main-thread parse up ~300ms.
hiro: link?
nina: https://console/telemetry/heatmap?env=canary  p95 jumped from 140ms to 430ms around 23:10 UTC.
sam: suspecting two things: 1) quota throttling on prefetch paths -> increased sequential fetches, 2) splitpoint change pushed worker behind shared-ui chunk so parse/eval now blocks longer.
kevin: which quota change? we lowered concurrent-prefetch from 8->4 for the rollout.
hiro: that would increase head-of-line for tile requests if kvcache misses happen. do we have kvcache miss-rate by route?
nina: not yet a dashboard metric; had to run ad-hoc query. shows miss-rate up from 0.5% -> 2.7% for heatmap-route.
sam: quick mitigations: 1) revert concurrent-prefetch to 8 in canary (cheap), 2) bump kvcache TTL for heatmap, 3) make heatmap splitpoint inline for canary.
kevin: I can flip prefetch quota now. infra-bot: Change submitted: https://infra/changes/5902 1: awaiting approval.
hiro: also can we reduce parse work by lazy-loading analytics from the shared-visuals chunk only after initial paint? small code change but might help.
sam: longer term we should add per-route policy metadata: {"prefetchQuota": number, "kvcacheTTL": ms, "splitpointPriority": "inline|lazy"}. global knobs are causing noisy cross-cutting regressions.
kevin: agree. will file infra task.
devops-bot: Canary change 5902 applied: prefetchQuota set to 8 for heatmap-route.
nina: monitoring now 1m in - p95 dropped to ~210ms. still above baseline.
hiro: TTL bump might address remainder; nina can we run a canary that sets kvcache TTL=30s only for heatmap?
nina: yes I'll push a scoped canary in 10m and share rollout link.
sam: add dashboard tiles: kvcache-miss-rate by route, prefetch-queue-length, and combined cold-load penalty (parse+kvmiss+network). alerts: combined p95 > 300ms.
kevin: ticket created: https://tasks/RED-3504 1 - includes infra work for per-route metadata spike.
hiro: note for runbooks: when changing splitpoint priorities, run a quick canary with kvcache profiler enabled; it captures prefix miss fallout. saved us last time.
nina: good call. deploying TTL canary now: https://ci.redwood/rollouts/5903/status. will update in 8m.
kevin: also watch memory usage after TTL bump - tradeoff is increased prefix cache.
devops-bot: Rollout 5903: success in canary region.
nina: 8m snapshot: p95 is 180ms now. kvcache miss-rate down to 0.8%. looks like combined fixes helped.
sam: awesome. will include learnings in the chunking/rollout checklist: per-route test matrix: prefetchQuota, kvcacheTTL, splitpointPriority, and memory monitor.
hiro: jotting that down. thanks team.
